summary: LangWatch is an open-source, OpenTelemetry-native platform for testing, evaluating and monitoring AI agents and LLM apps: agent simulation testing, LLM observability and tracing, offline and online evaluations, prompt management, an AI gateway, and usage and governance for coding agents. Use the cloud or self-host it.

keyPages.title: Agent simulation testing
keyPages.description: Test AI agents with scenario simulations before they reach production: simulate real conversations, catch regressions and prove agent quality every release.

keyPages.title: LLM observability
keyPages.description: OpenTelemetry-native LLM observability: trace every agent step, monitor cost and latency, and debug AI in production.

keyPages.title: LLM evaluation
keyPages.description: Evaluate LLM and agent quality with offline and online evals, custom evaluators and datasets, and catch quality regressions before users do.

keyPages.title: Prompt management
keyPages.description: Prompts as one versioned source of truth: version, review through GitHub, A/B test in production and tie every prompt to its traces.

keyPages.title: Voice agent testing
keyPages.description: Automated testing for voice and chat agents: open-source simulation, latency and quality checks, and production monitoring for voice AI.

keyPages.title: LLM red-teaming
keyPages.description: Open-source adversarial testing for AI agents: multi-turn attacks that surface jailbreaks, prompt extraction and data exfiltration before they ship.

keyPages.title: Instant Evals
keyPages.description: Search your entire production history with on-demand evals: ask one question of every conversation, thread or LLM call.

keyPages.title: AI Gateway
keyPages.description: An AI gateway that puts every AI call on a budget: limits per person, team and customer, your own provider keys, zero markup.

keyPages.title: Coding agent usage tracking
keyPages.description: Trace history, token and cost tracking for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor and Pi.

keyPages.title: Integrations
keyPages.description: Every integration LangWatch ships: Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs, OpenTelemetry, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Vertex, LangGraph, CrewAI, DSPy and more.

keyPages.title: Pricing
keyPages.description: Free Developer plan to start; paid plans add unlimited evaluations and simulations, enterprise security and self-hosting.

keyPages.title: Enterprise
keyPages.description: SSO, SCIM, custom RBAC, audit logs, self-hosting and EU data residency for governing agents at scale.

keyPages.title: Trust center
keyPages.description: Security and compliance: ISO 27001, GDPR, SOC 2, encryption, RBAC, SSO and self-hosting options.

keyPages.title: Langfuse alternative
keyPages.description: How LangWatch compares with Langfuse: agent simulations, voice testing, evals that product experts run themselves, CI gates, licensing and EU hosting.

keyPages.title: LangSmith alternative
keyPages.description: How LangWatch compares with LangSmith: framework-agnostic, OpenTelemetry-native and open source, without LangChain lock-in.

keyPages.title: Braintrust alternative
keyPages.description: How LangWatch compares with Braintrust: agent simulation, open source and a workflow for the whole team.

keyPages.title: Arize alternative
keyPages.description: How LangWatch compares with Arize: built for LLMs and agents rather than retrofitted from classic ML monitoring.

keyPages.title: The Evals Golden Guide
keyPages.description: A practical guide to evaluating LLM applications and AI agents.

keyPages.title: The AI Agents Guide
keyPages.description: A practical guide to building, testing and running AI agents in production.
